known_issues.check: CHECKED FOR BUT NEVER USED AS EVIDENCE
known_issues.reason: It is used, as (no X) in 'Diagnose possible TB in HIV patient before starting ART' (Q1 = No). The gate's NO_RE only strips a trailing "No" qualifier, but for a finding with a qualifier the "No" is rendered before the (qualifier ...), so the gate does not match it. Faithful encoding kept.
